facts.fact: LANA, citing the Ministry of Telecommunications and Informatics, names the National Telecommunications and Informatics Strategy as (2023-2027) (published 2026-10-08).
The Ministry says the US cooperation framework signed by the GACI head aligns with the strategy, which aims to develop digital infrastructure and the sector's efficiency; no budget line is stated.

A strategic cooperation framework with the US State Department was signed in Washington on about 2026-10-05 (inferred from 'last Monday' in a report published 2026-10-08) and is described as aligned with the strategy.

systems.owner: General Authority for Communications and Informatics (GACI)
